summary: Require acquired recipe machines and retain their actual science frontier.
details: Research acquisition now requires an obtainable matching machine placement item or a declared native capture route. A category prototype cannot supply an unavailable lab construction route, and circular machine/product bootstrap paths remain withheld.

Native capture preserves matching spawner transformations through obtainable compatible ammunition and launchers; fixed recipes and common surface conditions remain required. Machine, launcher and ammunition unlocks join the selected science frontier.

Controlled canonical laboratory and researchability consumers cover both modern adapters. Native catalogue, placement/capture, output, save and performance acceptance remain pending; other scripted or trigger-created machine mechanisms require their own qualification.

target_dispositions.reason: Corrects shared recipe/machine acquisition and frontier dependencies; native catalogue, output, lifecycle and save effects remain unqualified. Native capture recognition is bounded to target capability and concrete input contracts.
